name: testscript
description: TestScript: multi-tenant manual test case management

scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.replit:dev: npm install && npm run migrate && WEB_PORT=5000 npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm test -w shared && npm test -w api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w frontend
